'''Bafwizzy''' was the largest and [[Color/Legends|greenest]] of the nine [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], which was located in the [[Chad system/Legends|Chad system]], a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="Stay on Target" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Despite being the largest of Chad's moons,<ref name="Stay on Target" /> Bafwizzy was still small.<ref name="QotE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref> Along with the other moons, Bafwizzy contributed to the planet's complex system of [[Water/Legends|tides]]. The combination of the tides with [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] could cause [[Tsunami/Legends|tsunamis]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

During one such event, the [[Chadran disaster]],<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> which occurred on an afternoon<ref name="Stay on Target" /> at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'' establishes that the [[Chadran disaster]] had occurred prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes to have begun in [[0 BBY/Legends|O BBY]].</ref> Bafwizzy was overhead and bright, even though it was still [[Local day/Legends|daytime]].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]</ref> when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] approached Chad in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the pair could see all nine of Chad's moons, which appeared as small specks of light.<ref name="QotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The nine moons of Chad were first mentioned in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> The moons made their first full appearance in ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', a [[1993]] novel by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]] as part of the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] series.<ref name="QotE" /> Bafwizzy was first identified by name and expounded upon in the [[2015]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Chad system/Legends|Chad system]], and therefore Bafwizzy, in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
